objs.name: document
objs.description: A physical or logical artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedures, or work instructions that undergo creation, editing, review, release, and archiving in the management system.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedure, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of document including Creation, Review, Released, Archived, or Out of Force

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the document

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which document becomes effective

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date after which document validity must be extended or document becomes out of force

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code identifier for the document

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language version of the document content

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document or file linked to a main document that is released with the main document and affects its version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Release status of the attachment

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A non-critical document supplement not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Whether additional information is published or not

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who performs roles and actions in the document management process.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Role assigned to user such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, or Translator

attributes.name: authorization
attributes.description: Read and write permissions for specific documents or object types

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned together for authorization and distribution purposes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the user group

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, or Archive

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A request to amend an existing document without affecting its content or version history until implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of the change proposal such as Created, Scheduled, or Completed

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to review and extend document validity for a defined period.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the validity extension request

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has valid status.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the override request

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to restore a previously invalidated document to active status.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the reactivation request

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of users and user groups assigned to receive document notifications or acknowledgement requests.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Distribution method such as Email or Acknowledgement

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic signature provided by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow task.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when signature was applied

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: User who provided the signature

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A process that manages document creation, review, release, validity extension, or invalidation with participant tasks.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification such as Release, Validity Extension, Override, or Reactivation

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of workflow execution

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: An action by which a user confirms receipt and understanding of a released document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Confirmed or Pending state of acknowledgement

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new document object with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content and properties using integrated editing client.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system conversion of document to PDF format after saving.

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiation of the workflow-supported 3-step release process by author or co-author.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Examination of document content by assigned reviewers for technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and publication of document by assigned releaser making it visible to readers.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature application by workflow participant to confirm task completion.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Addition of a controlled document attachment to a main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of attachment for archiving when no longer relevant to document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submission of a proposed amendment to an existing document by authorized user.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a new document version incorporating an approved change proposal.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirmation that document remains valid and update of valid until date by authorized participants.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Submission of request to invalidate and archive a document with no remaining validity.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declaration of document as out of force and revocation of user authorizations except archive group.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdrawal of document from active circulation with restricted access except to archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Submission of request to restore an archived document to active status by authorized user.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restoration of previously invalidated document to active status with new version created.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Creation of language-dependent version of released document content.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Examination of translated document content by assigned reviewers.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approval of translated document version making it visible to authorized readers in target language.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Sending of email notification to users and user groups when new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic email request to users and user groups for active confirmation of document receipt.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: User confirmation of document receipt and understanding via workflow-supported task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Definition and allocation of read and write permissions to users and user groups for specific documents.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Production of role-specific evaluation report or dashboard for document status and search.

o2o.description: A document contains attachments that are released and versioned with the main document.
A document can be supplemented with additional information not subject to the main release cycle.
Change proposals are linked to and belong to a specific document.
Documents can reference other documents and can have dependent language versions.
A validity extension request is linked to a document requiring validity review.
An override request is linked to a document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request targets a previously invalidated document.
Documents are assigned to distribution lists defining which users receive notifications and acknowledgements.
Users are members of user groups that determine their authorizations and notification distribution.
Users have specific authorization roles on documents such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Reader.
Workflows are created to manage the lifecycle processes of documents.
Change proposals are bounded to a document and reference the document they propose to amend.

o2e.description: User creates a new document by attachment of information object.
User modifies document content and properties.
Document is automatically converted to PDF format.
User initiates the release workflow process.
Assigned reviewer examines document content.
Assigned releaser approves and publishes document.
Workflow participant applies electronic signature.
Electronic signature is created during document signing.
User adds controlled attachment to document.
Attachment is marked for archiving.
Authorized user submits a proposed amendment.
Change proposal is incorporated into new document version.
Authorized participant confirms document validity and extends valid until date.
Document validity is extended for defined period.
Validity extension request is processed and resolved.
User with write access submits override request.
Authorized participant declares document out of force.
Override request results in document invalidation.
Document is withdrawn from circulation and archived.
Business admin user submits reactivation request.
Initiator confirms reactivation of archived document.
Reactivation request results in document restoration.
Translator creates language-dependent version of released document.
Assigned reviewer examines translated content.
Assigned releaser approves translated document version.
User group members receive email notification of document release.
Assigned user receives email notification of document release.
Distribution list defines recipients for email notification.
User group members are requested to confirm document acknowledgement.
Assigned user is requested to confirm document acknowledgement.
Distribution list defines recipients for acknowledgement request.
User confirms receipt and understanding of document.
Acknowledgement record is created and confirmed.
Technical administrator assigns read and write permissions to users.
Technical administrator assigns permissions to user groups.
Authorizations are defined and assigned per document.
Role-specific user generates evaluation report or dashboard.
Report includes document status and related information.
